meaning.en: (colloquial, usually in the plural) The pectoralis major muscle.

sentences.en: PEC (Polyethylene glycol)-CELL (cellulose) grafted copolymer was prepared by grafting PEG to CELL chemically.

sentences.en: It is supposed that the dissolving mechanism of PEC is the cooperating results of the dissociation function and the hydrophobic action of the ionic surfactant.

sentences.en: Analytical modeling for response of differential probes placed above arbitrary number of parallel nonferrous stratified conductive structures for pulsed eddy current(PEC) testing was studied.

sentences.en: This thesis introduces microsphere lithography ( MSL ) and photoelectrochemical (PEC) etching, and describes how to fabricate sub-micro triangular rods by these methods.

sentences.en: Methods: The mutation for ALD were studied with PEC micronucleus test in bone marrow cell of mice in vivo and chromosomal aberration test of CHL in vitro for ALD.
